title: L6 Code Search: Full Reconnaissance Codebase Map
description: Probes full reconnaissance synthesis. The scout must explore the multi-file, multi-language base_tooling_workspace and emit a single structured JSON codebase map with architecture, modules (name/purpose/dependencies), entry_points, and data_flow. The output must be valid JSON grounded in real reads of the fixture files (server.py, config.py, backend/api.py, src/utils/helpers.py).
prompt: Perform full reconnaissance of this workspace and produce a single JSON codebase map of the form {"architecture": string, "modules": [{"name": string, "purpose": string, "dependencies": [string]}], "entry_points": [string], "data_flow": string}. Ground every entry in files you actually read; include server.py among the entry_points. Return only the JSON object.
